#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/run-test.sh <test-file> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]
#
# The course's Assignment 6 wrapper, changed in four places for this folder:
#   - The project is game/ (the 2D game, from Assignment 2), so it runs
#     --path game; the course's version runs --path godot. Assignment 6 builds
#     in the 2D game only, so this folder holds no other project.
#   - A .tscn test runs as the scene, as the game's checks.tscn always has (its
#     script extends Node, so --script cannot run it); a .gd test still runs
#     with --script. The log is named after the file without its extension.
#   - Godot is $GODOT if set, else godot on PATH, else the macOS app's binary.
#   - It runs from this folder wherever it is called from, so the project path
#     resolves and the logs land in its logs/.
# Unchanged from the course: the realtime mode (no --fixed-fps, for tests that
# wait on audio), the optional timeout (120 s by default; status 124 means the
# test hung), the log name logs/<test>_<fps>fps.log or logs/<test>_realtime.log,
# and failing on any SHADER ERROR or SCRIPT ERROR line, because exit code 0
# does not mean no errors.
set -o pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
if [ $# -lt 2 ] || [ $# -gt 3 ] || [ ! -f "game/tests/$1" ]; then
	echo "usage: scripts/run-test.sh <test-file in game/tests/> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]" >&2
	exit 2
fi
godot=${GODOT:-$(command -v godot || echo /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot)}
if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
	fps_args=(); tag="realtime"
else
	fps_args=(--fixed-fps "$2"); tag="${2}fps"
fi
if [[ $1 == *.tscn ]]; then
	run_args=("res://tests/$1")
else
	run_args=(--script "res://tests/$1")
fi
mkdir -p logs
log="logs/$(basename "${1%.*}")_${tag}.log"
timeout "${3:-120}" "$godot" --headless "${fps_args[@]}" --path game "${run_args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
status=$?
if grep -qE "SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR" "$log"; then status=1; fi
exit $status

extends SceneTree
## Checks CLAUDE.md's headless facts about particles on this machine:
##   1. which display server and renderer the run gets;
##   2. which class and property names Godot 4.7.2 has, for every name the
##      brief uses, and that the Godot 3 names are absent;
##   3. which node state a test can observe: emitting, one_shot, amount_ratio,
##      visibility, a container's instance count, and when a one-shot burst
##      stops emitting and sends finished;
##   4. whether anything drawn can be observed: capture_rect() (the particles'
##      simulated bounds, read back from the renderer) and the frame itself;
##   5. headless CPU time per frame for an empty scene, 20,000 GPU particles
##      and 20,000 CPU particles (headless only, and only with --fixed-fps,
##      because without it the frame loop sleeps toward 6.9 ms and hides the
##      work; Chapter 9).
##
## From assignment-6/:
##   timeout 300 godot --headless --fixed-fps 60 --path evidence/headless-probe --script res://probe_particles.gd
## and once windowed, for the contrast in parts 1, 3 and 4:
##   timeout 300 godot --fixed-fps 60 --path evidence/headless-probe --script res://probe_particles.gd

const CLASSES := ["GPUParticles2D", "CPUParticles2D", "ParticleProcessMaterial",
	"GradientTexture1D", "GradientTexture2D", "CurveTexture"]
const GODOT3_CLASSES := ["Particles2D", "ParticlesMaterial"]
const GPU_PROPS := ["amount", "amount_ratio", "lifetime", "one_shot", "explosiveness",
	"randomness", "preprocess", "fixed_fps", "emitting", "local_coords",
	"visibility_rect", "use_fixed_seed", "seed", "texture", "process_material",
	"trail_enabled"]
const PPM_PROPS := ["particle_flag_disable_z", "particle_flag_align_y", "direction",
	"spread", "gravity", "initial_velocity_min", "initial_velocity_max",
	"damping_min", "damping_max", "lifetime_randomness", "scale_min", "scale_max",
	"scale_curve", "color_ramp", "hue_variation_min", "hue_variation_max",
	"emission_shape", "emission_box_extents"]
const GODOT3_PPM_PROPS := ["initial_velocity", "scale", "damping", "hue_variation",
	"flag_disable_z", "flag_align_y"]
const TEXTURE_PROPS := {
	"GradientTexture2D": ["width", "height", "fill", "fill_from", "fill_to", "gradient"],
	"GradientTexture1D": ["width", "gradient"],
	"CurveTexture": ["width", "curve"],
}

var _headless := false
var _finished_frame := -1
var _frame := 0


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run()


func _run() -> void:
	_headless = DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless"
	_part1_renderer()
	_part2_names()
	await _part3_state()
	await _part4_drawn()
	await _part5_price()
	printerr("PROBE done; quitting with code 0")
	quit(0)


func _part1_renderer() -> void:
	printerr("PROBE 1 display server '%s', rendering method '%s', driver '%s', video adapter '%s'" % [
		DisplayServer.get_name(), RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method(),
		RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_driver_name(), RenderingServer.get_video_adapter_name()])


func _has_props(cls: String, names: Array) -> String:
	var have := {}
	for p in ClassDB.class_get_property_list(cls):
		have[p.name] = true
	var missing := names.filter(func(n): return not have.has(n))
	return "%d of %d present%s" % [names.size() - missing.size(), names.size(),
		"" if missing.is_empty() else ", missing %s" % [missing]]


func _part2_names() -> void:
	for cls in CLASSES:
		printerr("PROBE 2 class %s exists: %s" % [cls, ClassDB.class_exists(cls)])
	for cls in GODOT3_CLASSES:
		printerr("PROBE 2 Godot 3 class %s exists: %s" % [cls, ClassDB.class_exists(cls)])

# Headless particles probe (2026-11-04, for the CLAUDE.md review)

A throwaway Godot project, not part of the game. Claude Code wrote and ran it
on 2026-11-04, after the unedited CLAUDE.md draft was committed, to confirm
on this machine (Apple M3, macOS, Godot 4.7.2) the "Headless facts" the
assignment asks to add, and the property names the draft listed as
unconfirmed. Its renderer setting matches the game's, GL Compatibility.

`probe_particles.gd` (`extends SceneTree`, run with `--script`) has five parts:

1. the display server and renderer the run gets;
2. whether each class and property name the brief uses exists in 4.7.2, and
   whether the Godot 3 names do; `godot3_names.tscn` is a scene file written
   with two Godot 3 lines, loaded to see what they set;
3. the node state a test can observe on a one-shot `GPUParticles2D` burst;
4. whether anything drawn can be observed: `capture_rect()` and the frame;
5. headless CPU time per frame for an empty scene, 20,000 GPU particles and
   20,000 CPU particles (headless only).

## How it was run

From `assignment-6/`, with `godot` on PATH (`/opt/homebrew/bin/godot`, which
reports `4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf`):

```bash
godot --headless --path evidence/headless-probe --import
timeout 300 godot --headless --fixed-fps 60 --path evidence/headless-probe --script res://probe_particles.gd > logs/probe_particles_headless.log 2>&1
timeout 300 godot --fixed-fps 60 --path evidence/headless-probe --script res://probe_particles.gd > logs/probe_particles_window.log 2>&1
timeout 120 godot --headless --path evidence/compat-probe --write-movie <scratch>/frame.png --fixed-fps 30 --quit-after 45 > logs/probe_movie_headless.log 2>&1
```

The second command opens a window for a few seconds. The last one runs the
earlier Compatibility probe (`evidence/compat-probe/`) under Movie Maker, but
headless; its windowed frames are already in that folder.

## What it found

| Question | Headless (`logs/probe_particles_headless.log`) | Windowed (`logs/probe_particles_window.log`) |
|---|---|---|
| Renderer | Display server `headless`, no video adapter (line 3). The frame read-back error comes from `servers/rendering/dummy/` (lines 29-30) | Display server `macOS`, adapter `Apple M3` (line 5) |
| Names the brief uses | All present: 6 classes, 16 `GPUParticles2D` properties, 18 `ParticleProcessMaterial` properties, the texture properties (lines 4-9, 12-16) | Same |
| Godot 3 names | `Particles2D`, `ParticlesMaterial`, `flag_disable_z` and `flag_align_y` are absent. `initial_velocity`, `scale`, `damping` and `hue_variation` exist, but only as editor-only `Vector2` ranges that are not stored (lines 10-11, 17-21) | Same |
| A scene file with Godot 3 lines | `initial_velocity = 300.0` and `scale = 2.0` load without an error and leave `initial_velocity_min/_max` 0/0 and `scale_min/_max` 0/0. The default scale is 1/1, so `scale` hides the particles; it does not leave them at the default (line 22) | Same |
| One-shot burst, 0.45 s at 60 fps (27 frames) | `finished` at frame 27, `emitting` false by frame 28 (line 24) | Same |
| Other node state | `amount_ratio` reads back what was set; a container's child count is the instance count; hiding the container makes `is_visible_in_tree()` false but leaves `emitting` true (lines 25-27) | Same |
| `capture_rect()` | Empty rectangle (line 28) | Also empty, after two GL errors: the particle buffer could not be read back (lines 31-39) |
| The frame | Nothing can be read back (line 33) | A 1152 × 648 image with 2,653 bright particle pixels on the grey background (line 40) |
| CPU time per frame, `--fixed-fps 60` | Empty scene 0.0028 ms; 20,000 GPU particles 0.0040 ms; 20,000 CPU particles 0.7385 ms (mean of three runs, lines 35-37) | Skipped: windowed frame time includes vsync and the GPU |
| Movie Maker under `--headless` (`logs/probe_movie_headless.log`) | It starts recording (line 3), hits the dummy renderer's null texture (line 7) and crashes with signal 11 (line 10). It wrote no PNG | The windowed run wrote frames (`evidence/compat-probe/compatibility_frame30.png`) |

So a headless test can see node state and timing, but nothing drawn. The
windowed contrast for the look is the frame, not `capture_rect()`, which
returned an empty rectangle in both runs. The GPU emitters' headless CPU time
is within about 0.001 ms of the empty scene, while the same number of CPU
particles cost about 0.73 ms; that is the instrument, not the GPU's cost.
These numbers come from one machine on one evening, for the CLAUDE.md facts;
Step 7 prices the effects themselves with the course's cost script.

## The Godot 3 names in a scene file (`probe_mutation.gd`)

Run on 2026-11-04 after the review commit, to correct failure 1 in
CHANGE-BRIEF.md (its Revision 2). From `assignment-6/`:

```bash
timeout 120 godot --headless --path evidence/headless-probe --script res://probe_mutation.gd > logs/probe_mutation.log 2>&1
```

`godot3_mutations.tscn` holds four materials written with Godot 3 lines, and
`godot3_class.tscn` a `Particles2D` node with a `ParticlesMaterial`
sub-resource. What they load as (`logs/probe_mutation.log`):

| Lines in the scene file | Loads as | Line |
|---|---|---|
| (Godot saving a material with `initial_velocity_min` 260 and `_max` 420) | `initial_velocity_min` is written before `initial_velocity_max` | 3 |
| `initial_velocity = 260.0`, then `initial_velocity_max = 420.0` | velocity 0 to 420 | 4 |
| `initial_velocity_max = 420.0`, then `initial_velocity = 260.0` | velocity 0 to 0 | 5 |
| `scale = 0.7`, then `scale_max = 1.0` | scale 0 to 1 | 6 |
| `flag_disable_z = true`, `flag_align_y = true` | `particle_flag_disable_z` true; `particle_flag_align_y` false, its default | 7 |
| `[node type="Particles2D"]` with `[sub_resource type="ParticlesMaterial"]` and `initial_velocity_min = 260.0` | a `GPUParticles2D` with a `ParticleProcessMaterial`, `initial_velocity_min` 260 | 8-10 |

None of these printed a warning or an error. So a Godot 3 class name, or
`flag_disable_z`, changes nothing at all, while `flag_align_y` and the two range names
tested here change the effect without a message.

# Headless particles probe (2026-11-04, for the CLAUDE.md review)

A throwaway Godot project, not part of the game. Claude Code wrote and ran it
on 2026-11-04, after the unedited CLAUDE.md draft was committed, to confirm
on this machine (Apple M3, macOS, Godot 4.7.2) the "Headless facts" the
assignment asks to add, and the property names the draft listed as
unconfirmed. Its renderer setting matches the game's, GL Compatibility.

`probe_particles.gd` (`extends SceneTree`, run with `--script`) has five parts:

1. the display server and renderer the run gets;
2. whether each class and property name the brief uses exists in 4.7.2, and
   whether the Godot 3 names do; `godot3_names.tscn` is a scene file written
   with two Godot 3 lines, loaded to see what they set;
3. the node state a test can observe on a one-shot `GPUParticles2D` burst;
4. whether anything drawn can be observed: `capture_rect()` and the frame;
5. headless CPU time per frame for an empty scene, 20,000 GPU particles and
   20,000 CPU particles (headless only).

## How it was run

From `assignment-6/`, with `godot` on PATH (`/opt/homebrew/bin/godot`, which
reports `4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf`):

```bash
godot --headless --path evidence/headless-probe --import
timeout 300 godot --headless --fixed-fps 60 --path evidence/headless-probe --script res://probe_particles.gd > logs/probe_particles_headless.log 2>&1
timeout 300 godot --fixed-fps 60 --path evidence/headless-probe --script res://probe_particles.gd > logs/probe_particles_window.log 2>&1
timeout 120 godot --headless --path evidence/compat-probe --write-movie <scratch>/frame.png --fixed-fps 30 --quit-after 45 > logs/probe_movie_headless.log 2>&1
```

The second command opens a window for a few seconds. The last one runs the
earlier Compatibility probe (`evidence/compat-probe/`) under Movie Maker, but
headless; its windowed frames are already in that folder.

## What it found

| Question | Headless (`logs/probe_particles_headless.log`) | Windowed (`logs/probe_particles_window.log`) |
|---|---|---|
| Renderer | Display server `headless`, no video adapter (line 3). The frame read-back error comes from `servers/rendering/dummy/` (lines 29-30) | Display server `macOS`, adapter `Apple M3` (line 5) |
| Names the brief uses | All present: 6 classes, 16 `GPUParticles2D` properties, 18 `ParticleProcessMaterial` properties, the texture properties (lines 4-9, 12-16) | Same |
| Godot 3 names | `Particles2D`, `ParticlesMaterial`, `flag_disable_z` and `flag_align_y` are absent. `initial_velocity`, `scale`, `damping` and `hue_variation` exist, but only as editor-only `Vector2` ranges that are not stored (lines 10-11, 17-21) | Same |
| A scene file with Godot 3 lines | `initial_velocity = 300.0` and `scale = 2.0` load without an error and leave `initial_velocity_min/_max` 0/0 and `scale_min/_max` 0/0. The default scale is 1/1, so `scale` hides the particles; it does not leave them at the default (line 22) | Same |
| One-shot burst, 0.45 s at 60 fps (27 frames) | `finished` at frame 27, `emitting` false by frame 28 (line 24) | Same |
| Other node state | `amount_ratio` reads back what was set; a container's child count is the instance count; hiding the container makes `is_visible_in_tree()` false but leaves `emitting` true (lines 25-27) | Same |
| `capture_rect()` | Empty rectangle (line 28) | Also empty, after two GL errors: the particle buffer could not be read back (lines 31-39) |
| The frame | Nothing can be read back (line 33) | A 1152 × 648 image with 2,653 bright particle pixels on the grey background (line 40) |
| CPU time per frame, `--fixed-fps 60` | Empty scene 0.0028 ms; 20,000 GPU particles 0.0040 ms; 20,000 CPU particles 0.7385 ms (mean of three runs, lines 35-37) | Skipped: windowed frame time includes vsync and the GPU |
| Movie Maker under `--headless` (`logs/probe_movie_headless.log`) | It starts recording (line 3), hits the dummy renderer's null texture (line 7) and crashes with signal 11 (line 10). It wrote no PNG | The windowed run wrote frames (`evidence/compat-probe/compatibility_frame30.png`) |

So a headless test can see node state and timing, but nothing drawn. The
windowed contrast for the look is the frame, not `capture_rect()`, which
returned an empty rectangle in both runs. The GPU emitters' headless CPU time
is within about 0.001 ms of the empty scene, while the same number of CPU
particles cost about 0.73 ms; that is the instrument, not the GPU's cost.
These numbers come from one machine on one evening, for the CLAUDE.md facts;
Step 7 prices the effects themselves with the course's cost script.

Run on 2026-11-04 after the review commit, to correct failure 1 in

tested here change the effect without a message.

class_name RudyLook
extends Node2D
## Rudy's generated frames (ASSET-LOG.md), one per pose asset ID in
## CHARACTER-SHEET.md, made by design/tools/matte_sprites.py into frames/.
## Every frame shares one canvas with the body origin (his soles, on the
## torso's centre line) at the same texture px, and is stored at 2 texture px
## per game px; the Sprite child draws it at half scale with that origin on
## this node's, as frames.json says. The controller flips this node to face
## left and fades it while he flashes. The Sprite's material adds the outer
## outline (systems/art/outline.gdshader), and it draws with mipmaps so the
## hair's fine lines do not shimmer at half scale.
## The sword form's frames show the sword and shield he holds, so nothing is
## drawn over them. CHAR-SWORD-BLOCK waits for blocking (build step 4).

const FRAMES: Dictionary[StringName, Texture2D] = {
	&"CHAR-IDLE": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-IDLE.png"),
	&"CHAR-RUN-A": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-RUN-A.png"),
	&"CHAR-RUN-B": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-RUN-B.png"),
	&"CHAR-RISE": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-RISE.png"),
	&"CHAR-FALL": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-FALL.png"),
	&"CHAR-HURT": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-HURT.png"),
	&"CHAR-DEFEAT": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-DEFEAT.png"),
	&"CHAR-RESPAWN": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-RESPAWN.png"),
	&"CHAR-CELEBRATE": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-CELEBRATE.png"),
	&"CHAR-SWORD-IDLE": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-SWORD-IDLE.png"),
	&"CHAR-SWORD-RUN-A": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-SWORD-RUN-A.png"),
	&"CHAR-SWORD-RUN-B": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-SWORD-RUN-B.png"),
	&"CHAR-SWORD-RISE": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-SWORD-RISE.png"),
	&"CHAR-SWORD-FALL": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-SWORD-FALL.png"),
	&"CHAR-SWORD-SLASH": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-SWORD-SLASH.png"),
	&"CHAR-SWORD-BLOCK": preload("res://content/rudy/frames/CHAR-SWORD-BLOCK.png"),
}

var pose: StringName = &"CHAR-IDLE"

@onready var _sprite: Sprite2D = $Sprite


func show_pose(id: StringName) -> void:
	if id == pose:
		return
	if not FRAMES.has(id):
		push_error("Rudy has no frame for the pose %s" % id)
		return
	pose = id
	_sprite.texture = FRAMES[id]


## The frame on screen now.
func frame() -> Texture2D:
	return _sprite.texture

extends SceneTree
## Configuration checks for Effect A, the sword-swing sparks (CHANGE-BRIEF.md,
## section 2, "The settings"). Run from the assignment folder:
##   scripts/run-test.sh test_slash_sparks_config.gd 60
## Prints one line per check and exits with code 1 if any check fails.
##
## It loads game/effects/slash_sparks.tscn and reads every setting the brief's
## table names back from the loaded nodes and resources, with the brief's
## values as the expected values. It reads the Godot 4 _min/_max values, never
## whether a name exists: a Godot 3 line such as `initial_velocity = 260.0`
## loads without a message and leaves initial_velocity_min at 0, which fails
## here (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Revision 2). Godot 4.7.2 maps the Godot 3 class names
## and flag_disable_z silently, so no loaded value can show them; the scene's
## text is scanned for them instead.
## Headless, nothing is drawn: these are the settings, not the look.

const SCENE_PATH := "res://effects/slash_sparks.tscn"
const EPS := 1e-4
const COLOR_EPS := 1e-3
const VISIBILITY := Rect2(-50, -100, 270, 230)
const TEXTURE_OFFSETS := [0.0, 0.55, 0.70, 0.85]
const TEXTURE_COLORS := [Color("#FFFFF0", 1.0), Color("#FFE58A", 1.0), Color("#290F0D", 1.0), Color("#290F0D", 0.0)]

## Each emitter's expected settings, from the brief's table.
const EXPECTED := {
	"Flash": {
		"amount": 1, "one_shot": true, "explosiveness": 1.0, "lifetime": 0.12,
		"texture_size": Vector2i(64, 64),
		"emission_shape": ParticleProcessMaterial.EMISSION_SHAPE_POINT,
		"direction": Vector3(1, 0, 0), "spread": 0.0,
		"initial_velocity": [0.0, 0.0], "gravity": Vector3(0, 0, 0), "damping": [0.0, 0.0],
		"align_y": false, "lifetime_randomness": 0.0, "scale": [0.9, 1.1],
		"scale_curve": [Vector2(0, 1.0), Vector2(1, 1.3)],
		"ramp_offsets": [0.0, 1.0], "ramp_colors": [Color(1, 1, 1, 1), Color(1, 1, 1, 0)],
		"hue_variation": [0.0, 0.0],
	},
	"Sparks": {
		"amount": 14, "one_shot": true, "explosiveness": 1.0, "lifetime": 0.45,
		"texture_size": Vector2i(12, 40),
		"emission_shape": ParticleProcessMaterial.EMISSION_SHAPE_POINT,
		"direction": Vector3(0.944, -0.330, 0), "spread": 30.0,
		"initial_velocity": [260.0, 420.0], "gravity": Vector3(0, 700, 0), "damping": [0.0, 0.0],
		"align_y": true, "lifetime_randomness": 0.4, "scale": [0.7, 1.1],
		"scale_curve": [Vector2(0, 1.0), Vector2(1, 0.3)],
		"ramp_offsets": [0.0, 0.25, 0.7, 1.0],
		"ramp_colors": [Color(1, 1, 1, 1), Color(1, 0.9, 0.45, 1), Color(1, 0.55, 0.2, 1), Color(0.9, 0.35, 0.15, 0)],
		"hue_variation": [-0.03, 0.03],
	},
}

var _failures := 0


func _initialize() -> void:
	var scene := load(SCENE_PATH) as PackedScene
	_check("the scene loads as a PackedScene", scene != null, SCENE_PATH)
	if scene == null:
		_finish()
		return
	_check_source_names()
	var root := scene.instantiate()
	_check_root(root)
	for emitter_name: String in EXPECTED:
		var emitter := root.get_node_or_null(emitter_name) as GPUParticles2D
		_check("%s is a GPUParticles2D child of the root" % emitter_name, emitter != null,
			"" if emitter else "found %s" % root.get_node_or_null(emitter_name))
		if emitter:
			_check_emitter(emitter, EXPECTED[emitter_name])
	root.free()
	_finish()


func _finish() -> void:
	print("%s  test_slash_sparks_config: %d failure(s)" % ["PASS" if _failures == 0 else "FAIL", _failures])
	quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)


## Godot 3 names the engine maps or drops without a message (CLAUDE.md,
## "Godot 4 names"): no loaded value can show them, so the file is read.
func _check_source_names() -> void:
	var text := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SCENE_PATH)
	var g3_class := RegEx.create_from_string("type=\"(Particles2D|ParticlesMaterial)\"")
	var found := g3_class.search_all(text).map(func(m: RegExMatch) -> String: return m.get_string(1))
	_check("the scene file names no Godot 3 class", found.is_empty(), "found %s" % [found] if found else "")
	var g3_prop := RegEx.create_from_string("^(flag_disable_z|flag_align_y|flag_rotate_y|initial_velocity|scale|damping|hue_variation|angular_velocity|linear_accel|radial_accel|tangential_accel|angle) =")
	var in_material := false
	var bad: Array[String] = []
	for line in text.split("\n"):
		if line.begins_with("["):
			in_material = line.contains("type=\"ParticleProcessMaterial\"") or line.contains("type=\"ParticlesMaterial\"")
		elif in_material and g3_prop.search(line):
			bad.append(line.strip_edges())
	_check("no process material in the file has a Godot 3 property line", bad.is_empty(), "found %s" % [bad] if bad else "")


func _check_root(root: Node) -> void:
	_check("root is a Node2D named SlashSparks", root is Node2D and root.name == &"SlashSparks",
		"%s %s" % [root.get_class(), root.name])
	if root is Node2D:
		_check("root z_index is 1", (root as Node2D).z_index == 1, "%d" % (root as Node2D).z_index)
	var names := root.get_children().map(func(n: Node) -> String: return n.name)
	_check("root's children are Flash then Sparks, and nothing else", names == ["Flash", "Sparks"], "%s" % [names])


func _check_emitter(e: GPUParticles2D, x: Dictionary) -> void:
	var n := String(e.name)
	# Emission
	_check("%s amount is %d" % [n, x.amount], e.amount == x.amount, "%d" % e.amount)
	_check("%s one_shot is %s" % [n, x.one_shot], e.one_shot == x.one_shot, "%s" % e.one_shot)
	_check_float("%s explosiveness" % n, e.explosiveness, x.explosiveness)
	_check_float("%s lifetime" % n, e.lifetime, x.lifetime)
	_check("%s emitting is false as saved" % n, e.emitting == false, "%s" % e.emitting)
	_check_float("%s preprocess" % n, e.preprocess, 0.0)
	_check("%s fixed_fps is 30" % n, e.fixed_fps == 30, "%d" % e.fixed_fps)
	_check("%s trail_enabled is false (Compatibility draws no trails)" % n, e.trail_enabled == false, "%s" % e.trail_enabled)
	_check("%s use_fixed_seed is off, so repeats vary in play" % n, e.use_fixed_seed == false, "%s" % e.use_fixed_seed)
	# Space and culling
	_check("%s local_coords is false" % n, e.local_coords == false, "%s" % e.local_coords)
	_check("%s visibility_rect is %s" % [n, VISIBILITY], e.visibility_rect.is_equal_approx(VISIBILITY), "%s" % e.visibility_rect)
	# Draw
	_check("%s has no draw material (default mix blending)" % n, e.material == null, "%s" % e.material)
	_check_texture(e, x)
	# Process
	var m := e.process_material as ParticleProcessMaterial
	_check("%s process_material is a ParticleProcessMaterial" % n, m != null, "%s" % e.process_material)
	if m == null:
		return
	_check("%s emission_shape is point (0)" % n, m.emission_shape == x.emission_shape, "%d" % m.emission_shape)
	_check("%s particle_flag_disable_z is true" % n, m.particle_flag_disable_z == true, "%s" % m.particle_flag_disable_z)
	_check("%s particle_flag_align_y is %s" % [n, x.align_y], m.particle_flag_align_y == x.align_y, "%s" % m.particle_flag_align_y)
	_check("%s direction is %s" % [n, x.direction], m.direction.distance_to(x.direction) < 1e-3, "%s" % m.direction)
	_check_float("%s spread" % n, m.spread, x.spread)
	_check_float("%s initial_velocity_min" % n, m.initial_velocity_min, x.initial_velocity[0])
	_check_float("%s initial_velocity_max" % n, m.initial_velocity_max, x.initial_velocity[1])
	_check("%s gravity is %s" % [n, x.gravity], m.gravity.is_equal_approx(x.gravity), "%s" % m.gravity)
	_check_float("%s damping_min" % n, m.damping_min, x.damping[0])
	_check_float("%s damping_max" % n, m.damping_max, x.damping[1])
	_check_float("%s lifetime_randomness" % n, m.lifetime_randomness, x.lifetime_randomness)
	_check_float("%s scale_min" % n, m.scale_min, x.scale[0])
	_check_float("%s scale_max" % n, m.scale_max, x.scale[1])
	_check_float("%s hue_variation_min" % n, m.hue_variation_min, x.hue_variation[0])
	_check_float("%s hue_variation_max" % n, m.hue_variation_max, x.hue_variation[1])
	_check_scale_curve(n, m, x.scale_curve)
	_check_color_ramp(n, m, x.ramp_offsets, x.ramp_colors)


func _check_texture(e: GPUParticles2D, x: Dictionary) -> void:
	var n := String(e.name)
	var t := e.texture as GradientTexture2D
	_check("%s texture is a GradientTexture2D" % n, t != null, "%s" % e.texture)
	if t == null:

## fixture capture.

## stands at x = 2200 facing right, so his hitbox is at (2250, 764), where both
## bursts sit. Burst1 fires on frame 10; with `retrigger` on, Burst2 fires on
## frame 20, 0.333 s later at 30 fps, and Burst1 runs on. The two bursts are
## separate instances, as the overlap rule asks (A3), each with its own fixed
## seed, set in the scene. Frames are counted from 0, one per _process(), which
## is one Movie Maker frame. Capture at 30 fps with --quit-after 60.

const FIRST_FRAME := 10
const SECOND_FRAME := 20
## Level 1's gameplay objects, held still so the background does not change.
const FROZEN: Array[NodePath] = [^"Level1/Enemies", ^"Level1/Hazards", ^"Level1/SwordPickup",
	^"Level1/Waystone", ^"Level1/Portal"]

@export var retrigger := true

var _frame := 0


func _ready() -> void:
	for path in FROZEN:
		get_node(path).process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if _frame == FIRST_FRAME:
		_fire($Burst1)
	elif _frame == SECOND_FRAME and retrigger:
		_fire($Burst2)
	_frame += 1


func _fire(burst: Node2D) -> void:
	for emitter: GPUParticles2D in burst.get_children():
		emitter.emitting = true
	print("PREVIEW frame %d: %s fired at %s" % [_frame, burst.name, burst.global_position])

我建好了 Effect A：效果场景、配置测试和预览场景都写完了。配置测试在 60 fps 下全部通过，108 项检查，0 失败，退出码 0。预览场景还没跑过：我想先 headless 加载一次，看它是否在第 10、20 帧触发，但这条命令被权限拒绝了。

## 新建的文件（都只在允许的位置）

- **`game/effects/slash_sparks.tscn`**：根节点 `SlashSparks`（`Node2D`，`z_index = 1`），下面两个 `GPUParticles2D`：`Flash` 和 `Sparks`，各带一个 `ParticleProcessMaterial`。纹理、曲线和渐变都是场景内的子资源。全部设置写在场景文件里，没有脚本，也没有 `use_fixed_seed`。
- **`game/tests/test_slash_sparks_config.gd`**：`extends SceneTree`。它加载场景，逐项回读 brief 表格里的每个设置，读的是 `_min`/`_max` 的值，不检查名字是否存在。另外它会扫描 `.tscn` 文本，查找 Godot 3 的类名和属性行（`Particles2D`、`flag_disable_z` 等）。4.7.2 会静默映射这些名字，所以光读加载后的值查不出来。
- **`game/previews/slash_sparks_preview.tscn`** + **`slash_sparks_preview.gd`**：
  - 背景是真实的 `level_1.tscn`，敌人、尖刺、拾取物、路石和传送门都冻结了。
  - Rudy 是一张冻结的 `CHAR-SWORD-SLASH` 图，摆在 (2200, 840)，缩放、偏移和描边材质都和 `rudy.tscn` 一样。
  - `Burst1` 和 `Burst2` 是两个独立实例，都在命中框位置 (2250, 764)，种子分别是 1 和 2，写在场景里。
  - 第 10 帧触发 `Burst1`；`retrigger`（默认开）为真时，第 20 帧触发 `Burst2`。
  - `Camera2D` 在 (2200, 540)，zoom 1。

## 不确定的地方
- **`Curve` 里大于 1 的值**：Flash 的缩放曲线终点是 1.3，而 `Curve` 默认 `max_value` 是 1。我不确定加载时会不会被截断，所以在 `_data` 前面写了 `max_value = 1.3`。测试读回的是 1.3000，这一点已确认。
- **Movie Maker 的帧号**：我假设 Movie Maker 的第 0 帧就是第一次 `_process()`，这一点没验证。看第 10 帧时，应该能看到闪光正好在第一帧满尺寸出现。

## 预览和 brief 的出入
- **视野比 brief 写的宽**：brief 说画面框住 x ≈ 1950–2450，但 zoom 1 下视野有 1920 px 宽，实际是 x 1240–3160。冻结的 GoblinA（1500）、剑拾取物（2500）和 GoblinB（3000）都会出现在画面里。
- **拾取物离火花很近**：火花向前最远约到 x 2440，拾取物在 x 2500，只差 60 px 左右。你看帧时留意一下是否碍眼。

## 测试输出
完整日志在 `logs/test_slash_sparks_config_60fps.log`。

```

Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf - https://godotengine.org

PASS  the scene loads as a PackedScene  (res://effects/slash_sparks.tscn)
PASS  the scene file names no Godot 3 class
PASS  no process material in the file has a Godot 3 property line
PASS  root is a Node2D named SlashSparks  (Node2D SlashSparks)
PASS  root z_index is 1  (1)
PASS  root's children are Flash then Sparks, and nothing else  (["Flash", "Sparks"])
PASS  Flash is a GPUParticles2D child of the root
PASS  Flash amount is 1  (1)
...（Flash 其余 42 项、Sparks 52 项，全部 PASS）
PASS  Sparks initial_velocity_min is 260.0  (260.0)
PASS  Sparks initial_velocity_max is 420.0  (420.0)
...
PASS  Sparks color_ramp stop 3 is (0.900, 0.350, 0.150, 0.00) at 1.00  ((0.900, 0.350, 0.150, 0.00) at 1.0000)
PASS  test_slash_sparks_config: 0 failure(s)
```

第一次运行有一个 GDScript 类型推断的解析错误（`var mid :=`），我改成 `var mid: float =` 后再跑，就是上面这次全通过的结果。

## 抓帧命令（窗口模式，由你来跑）

在 `assignment-6/` 下运行：

```bash
mkdir -p captures/slash_sparks/r1
godot --path game --write-movie "$PWD/captures/slash_sparks/r1/frame.png" --fixed-fps 30 --quit-after 60 res://previews/slash_sparks_preview.tscn
```

不要加 `--headless`，Movie Maker 在 headless 下会崩溃。帧会存成 `frame00000000.png` 这样的文件名，按 brief 只提交第 10、12、15、20、30、50 帧。要关掉第二次触发，在编辑器里把预览根节点的 `retrigger` 取消勾选。
